name_reason: Current name carries the Ghidra address residue _4d8ea (== its own entry 0x4d8ea), which the naming convention forbids. The crt_equivalent_ prefix and the matherr_default_return_zero descriptor already and correctly capture the role (the 'return 0' primitive the default _matherr handler forwards to); only the trailing _4d8ea must be dropped. Resulting name stays unique (sibling thunk is crt_equivalent_matherr_default_thunk). Rename deferred to Stage 2: the symbol is referenced from the extern decl + #pragma aux jmp target in src/crt/crt.c, src/include/crtcomp.h, and src/include/protos.h.
purpose: The 'return 0' primitive that the default _matherr handler forwards to: it is the JMP target of crt_equivalent_matherr_default_thunk_4d340 (the default contents of the user-matherr slot [0x539A8]); returning 0 signals 'I did not handle this error', so _matherr proceeds with its default diagnostic/errno behaviour.
logic_summary: Standard Watcom prologue/epilogue around a literal return 0. Body (7 bytes): PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP; XOR EAX,EAX; POP EBP; RET. Ignores its single arg (exc); the only EAX write is XOR EAX,EAX with no preceding CALL, so EAX = 0 unconditionally. RET has no operand (caller cleans the arg), confirming __cdecl.

params.name: exc
params.semantics: The matherr exception-struct pointer passed by the matherr ABI (PUSHed by _matherr as a single cdecl stack arg). The body never reads it; the parameter exists only so the symbol _matherr binds to (via the thunk and slot [0x539A8]) carries the correct cdecl signature.
params.reason: Name 'exc' accurately denotes the matherr exception struct and carries no address residue.

returns.semantics: Always 0 (XOR EAX,EAX). In the matherr contract, 0 means 'handler did not handle this error', causing _matherr to run its default behaviour (fputs diagnostic + __set_EDOM/__set_ERANGE + the exception struct's pre-populated retval).
